slides.say: You used and-and to show something conditionally, and a random zero appeared. Here is why.
And-and is short. If the left side is true, render the right side. If it is false, render nothing.
But if the left side is the number zero, the whole expression becomes zero. And React happily renders that zero.

slides.text: Don't put numbers on the left of &&.
slides.say: The fix: make the left side a real boolean, like count greater than zero.
